{{Quote|It all began with a call for help: the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk was being overrun, and its cities demolished.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Devastation of Kashyyyk''' was a campaign of rampage and destruction that took place on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began to fall apart. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Darcc]] thus decided to turn Kashyyyk into an Imperial safe world. Although Kashyyyk has been [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|occupied]] and its inhabitants [[Enslavement of Kashyyyk|enslaved]] from the early days of the Empire, Moff Darcc's campaign was more devastating than ever. Moff Darcc's Imperial forces associated with [[Pekt]]'s [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] undertook a planet-wide campaign of destruction to rid the planet of its native inhabitants. The Wookiees were exterminated or enslaved and deported to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] while the cities were all destroyed. As the Wookiees grow desperate, the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] contacted his son [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to get help from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Chewbacca and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] soon arrived on the planer and initiated the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberation of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="GB" />
